title: OL-20261112-93: Compare the sweep's cycle_metric run over run (STRANGE-LOOP-1)
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** daily lane sweep
**Done check:** grep:scripts/completion_sweep.sh::previous_cycle_metric
**Status:** open

completion_sweep.sh prints `cycle_metric leftover_after_sweep` each run. Store the previous value in loop-evidence and file a plus when the leftover count does not fall, so each run is measurably better than the last.
